configuration.description: Independent target trajectories and independent nested library task prefixes; all M/h comparisons remain paired within context cluster.

interpretation.bootstrap: Intervals resample independent context clusters and preserve paired M/horizon rows.
interpretation.forecast: Finite-library MSE and posterior-mean discrepancy are oracle-MSE normalized; score differences are finite-library minus continuous in nats.
interpretation.universality: Matched-R heterogeneity is descriptive and no universal collapse is assumed; sparse-bin maxima are diagnostics, not falsification tests.

reporting_revision.reason: Post-review interpretation correction using retained data only; no contexts regenerated.
